articleBodyHtml:
Personal Reactions and Hyperfixation

The speaker finds the bat transformation hilarious and expresses regret. They are also experiencing a hyperfixation on their character and ask about Dimitri.

The speaker is okay with their hyperfixation and is not bothered by it.
